Name: Rigol DG1022/DG1022A Dual-Channel Function/Arbitrary Waveform Generator (USB-TMC)
Notes: Built from docs/devices/rigol-dg1022/programming-manual.md (RIGOL Programming Guide - DG1000 Series, Jan. 2014, PGB06109-1110), which explicitly covers DG1022 and DG1022A as one command set - no model-specific commands found or excluded. The DG1022's ONLY remote interface is the rear-panel USB Device port (USB-TMC) - it has no RS-232 or GPIB, unlike most other profiles in this catalog. Most subsystems have a CH1 form (bare) and CH2 form (same keyword suffixed :CH2); Sweep, Burst, modulation (AM/FM/PM/FSK), Trigger, and the Counter are all CH1-only with no :CH2 form. FUNCtion? always reports ARB after FUNC DC or FUNC USER - it never echoes back DC; use FUNCtion:USER? or APPLy? to distinguish. APPLy:SQUare/APPLy:RAMP silently reset duty cycle/symmetry to 50%. NOISe/DC APPLy commands still require a frequency/amplitude placeholder (numeric or DEFault) even though the value is ignored. DATA/DATA:DAC silently overwrite volatile memory with no confirmation - copy anything worth keeping to nonvolatile memory (DATA:COPY) first. SYSTem:RWLock locks out the front-panel Local button entirely (needs a bus SYSTem:LOCal to release) - prefer SYSTem:REMote for interactive debugging. SYSTem:ERRor? is FIFO, drain in a loop until 0,"No error". COUPling:CHANNCopy is rejected while COUPling is ON. OUTPut:LOAD only corrects displayed/generated amplitude for an assumed load - it does not change the fixed 50-ohm physical source impedance.
